answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the grove count is verified against the zenith text itself, the vertex audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 184 aliases thus means producing 184 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
